name: Vivienne Sinclair
description: A jazz singer with a mysterious past.
personality: Wary but charming. She hides fear behind wit.

intro.text: You again. I told you I don't know anything about Lorne.

choices.text: I found this cufflink at your club.
choices.disabled_text: You’d need to show her something — maybe a clue.

choices.text: Come on, Viv. Talk to me.

soften.text: Don't make me regret this. He was in trouble. Real trouble.

cufflink.text: ...Lorne always wore those. I told him not to come back here.

warning.text: Because Leone was watching. And Lorne wasn’t careful.

trouble.text: He talked about a shipment, something he needed to hide. Maybe Mick knows more.

name: Leone Carro
description: A calm, calculating smuggler who runs the docks like a chessboard. Knows everything — and shows nothing.

intro.text: You walked into the wrong end of town, detective.

choices.text: I'm looking for a man named Lorne.
You’ve got shipments that don’t add up.
choices.disabled_text: You need evidence to confront him.

lorne.text: Lorne played a game. He lost.

gone.text: Gone. Like smoke in the rain.

bluff.text: ...You’ve been poking around too much. That ledger’s going to cost you.

name: Mick Donnelly
description: A greasy informant who thrives in shadows. Loyal only to whoever pays him.
personality: Grimy and gruff. Acts friendly but sells everything for the right price.

intro.text: Detective. Didn’t think you’d come sniffing ‘round here.

choices.text: I heard you know about the shipment.
You’ve been tailing Leone, haven’t you?

shipment.text: Word is Lenny was trying to move something big. Didn’t trust Leone anymore.

locker_hint.text: Told me he left it somewhere public. Safe. Look for a locker at the station.

distrust.text: Leone’s been paranoid. Thinks everyone’s flipping. Even Lenny.

paranoia.text: A photo showed up. Real blurry. Showed Lenny talking to someone in uniform.

photo.text: Maybe I do. But nothing's free. You got something to trade?

trade.text: Heh. Fancy. Fine, take the photo. Don’t lose it.

tailing.text: Leone’s been staying low. Warehouse at the docks. Guards come and go all night.

name: Leone Marzetti
description: The city's underground kingpin. Calm, calculating, always watching.
personality: Polite menace. Prefers threats dressed as compliments.

intro.text: You’re either brave or foolish, Detective. I haven’t decided yet.

accuse.text: Is that so? You come here waving stories like a badge. Careful who you flash it to.

dossier.text: So it’s true. You know. That complicates things.

confess.text: You think this city cares about confessions? Burn that paper or join Lenny.

deal.text: You walk away. I forget your name. That’s the deal.

shipment.text: That was business. It went wrong. Now I clean up.

threat.text: Let’s not pretend this is justice, Detective. We’re both shadows in the same fog.

name: Station Attendant
description: An overworked employee with little patience.
personality: Dismissive and tired, but not unhelpful if pressed.

intro.text: Locker keys are for paying customers. You got a claim ticket?

choices.text: I need access to Locker #413. It’s urgent.

deny.text: Urgent ain’t a magic word. No key, no entry.

choices.text: I found this in the trash. Match anything?

allow.text: Huh. That’s Lenny’s. He always lit up before the 9:05. Here—take the damn key.
